name: Smart Addons for Elementor
author: WP Boffins

sections.description:
Smart Addons for Elementor extends your favorite page builder with a handcrafted collection of 21 exclusive widgets covering 79 ready-made design variations. Every widget ships with multiple curated presets, so you can drop in a professional layout in seconds and then fine-tune it to match your brand — no coding required.

Built by WP Boffins, each module is lightweight, fully responsive, cross-browser compatible, and styled with clean, modern, conversion-focused design. Whether you are building a landing page, a business website, a portfolio, or a full eCommerce store, Smart Addons gives you the building blocks to create something beautiful — fast.

Check Our Demos

Why Choose Smart Addons for Elementor?

  • 21 Exclusive Widgets — A growing library of smart, purpose-built modules for Elementor.
  • 79 Ready-Made Design Variations — Multiple curated presets per widget let you switch looks instantly.
  • Fully Customizable — Colors, typography, spacing, animations, and more — all from the Elementor panel.
  • No Coding Required — Point, click, and customize. Perfect for beginners and pros alike.
  • Fully Responsive — Pixel-perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Cross-Browser Compatible — Consistent rendering in all modern browsers.
  • IcoMoon Icon Library — A built-in premium-style icon set, plus Font Awesome support.
  • Works With Any Theme — Any WordPress theme that supports Elementor.
  • Free Support — Friendly help whenever you need it.
  • Actively Maintained — Regular updates and WordPress compatibility checks.

The Complete Widget Library (with Design Variations)

  • Smart Button — 14 variations: Default + 13 animated button styles, including slide, dual-text, and split-text effects.
  • Smart Logo Carousel — 7 variations: Default + 6 logo slider/grid styles for partner and client logos.
  • Smart Scroll To Top — 6 variations: Default, Morph, Glass Morphism, Expand, Dual Tone, and Bounce Arrow buttons.
  • Smart Heading — 5 variations: Default, Icon Left & Right, Icon Center, Icon Bottom, and Icon & Subtitle on Top.
  • Smart Service — 5 variations: Default + 4 modern service box layouts with gradient and color backgrounds.
  • Smart Testimonial — 5 variations: Box layout (Default, Center, Background) and Slider layout (Default, Vertical).
  • Smart Countdown — 4 variations: Default + 3 eye-catching countdown counter styles.
  • Smart Progress Bar — 4 variations: Default, Classic, Striped, and Circle progress indicators.
  • Smart Reading Progress Bar — 4 variations: Default, Time, Dotted, and Status reading progress bars.
  • Smart Social Icon — 4 variations: Default + 3 social icon styles for sharing and follow links.
  • Smart Feature List — 3 variations: Classic List, Centered List, and Grid Box layout (with vertical/horizontal options).
  • Smart Tab — 3 variations: One, Two, and Three tab layouts with icon support and image side-by-side content.
  • Smart Team — 2 variations: Round and Default team member cards with social links.
  • Smart Portfolio — 2 variations: Block and Filter (mixitup) portfolio grids with bottom or overlap captions.
  • Smart Call To Action — 2 variations: Default and Style One with image or color backgrounds.
  • Smart Flip Box — 2 variations: Default Flip and Pricing Flip cards for interactive front/back content.
  • Smart Toggle — 2 variations: Default and Style One toggle switches with color schemes.
  • Smart Reviews — 2 variations: Grid Cards and Review Slider with star ratings.
  • Smart Before/After — 1 variation with horizontal and vertical comparison orientations.
  • Smart Tooltip — 1 variation with icon, image, or text triggers.
  • Smart Accordion — 1 variation with arrow, plus, or no icon toggles.

What Can You Build?

  • Landing pages and high-converting marketing sites
  • Agency, business, and corporate websites
  • Portfolios, testimonial walls, and review sections
  • Pricing tables and flip-card product showcases
  • Countdowns for product launches and special events
  • Team, service, and feature showcases
  • And much more — all without touching code.
sections.installation:
Since this plugin works with Elementor, make sure you have Elementor installed on your website.

Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New screen in WordPress.
  2. Search for Smart Addons For Elementor.
  3. Install and activate the plugin, that’s it.

Manual Installation

  1. Download Smart Addons for Elementor.
  2. Extract the smart-addons-for-elementor.zip file. You’ll get plugin files inside smart-addons-for-elementor directory.
  3. Upload the plugin directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Can I use Smart Addons without the Elementor Plugin?

Unfortunately, you can’t. You need to have the Elementor Plugin installed and activated to use Smart Addons for Elementor.

Does it work with any WordPress Theme?

Yes, it works with any WordPress theme that works with Elementor.

How many design variations are included?

Smart Addons currently includes 79 ready-made design variations across 21 widgets, giving you instant layout flexibility without extra work.

Will this plugin break my site after an update?

No. Updates are compatibility-checked and will not break your site or any existing elements.

Do I need coding knowledge to use it?

No. Every widget is fully visual — add it, pick a preset, and customize it from the Elementor panel.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1 – 16 Aug 2026

  • Fix: Accordion icon issue fixed
  • Update: WordPress 7.1 compatibility check

1.2.0 – 25 July 2026

  • Added 11 new widgets: Smart Button, Smart Call To Action, Smart Feature List, Smart Flip Box, Smart Progress Bar, Smart Reading Progress Bar, Smart Reviews, Smart Scroll To Top, Smart Social Icon, Smart Toggle and Smart Tooltip
  • Plugin-wide WordPress Coding Standards audit and cleanup (direct file-access guards, escaping, sanitization, i18n, formatting)
  • Fixed broken social icon links caused by a control key mismatch
  • Fixed a testimonial widget condition that never applied due to a typo’d control reference
  • Fixed a heading widget style where the gradient color was applied to the wrong title part
  • Fixed a feature list widget issue where a hover effect was silently skipped
  • Fixed invalid HTML markup in the service widget
  • Renamed Smart Counter Up widget to Smart Countdown to match its behavior
  • Corrected several mislabeled and misspelled widget control labels

1.1.0 – 23 May 2025

  • Restructured plugin codebase for improved maintainability
  • Compatibility with latest version of Elementor
  • Redesigned widgets with improved UI
  • WordPress 7.0 compatibility check

1.0.3 – 16 September 2024

  • WordPress 6.6 compatibility check

1.0.2 – 15 June 2021

  • WordPress 6.0 compatibility check

1.0.1 – 15 June 2021

  • Bug fixed.

1.0.0 – 16 December 2019

  • Initial Release
